name: After § 34
title: REPORT on the findings and recommendations of the Special Committee on the European Democracy Shield
part_text: 34a. Notes that EU support for media-related projects should contribute to a diverse, independent and pluralistic media environment; stresses that public funding must not create structural dependencies or incentives that could undermine editorial independence, encourage self-censorship or marginalise dissenting or critical voices; emphasises the need to ensure that EU-supported media initiatives do not contribute to the predominance of a single narrative or perspective, including in the context of foreign policy and external action; calls on the Commission to ensure full transparency and effective safeguards for the independence, diversity and accountability of media-financing schemes, including through independent monitoring of their implementation and impact on media pluralism;
